semantics: src/ is not modified. Every match goes through the official buildChallengeMatchSetup -> assembleMatch -> runChallenge tick loop, as the committed layer ladder. Interventions exist only in the tool: (1) contexts are the ladder's ladderSetup (copied verbatim; V1 checks it record by record); (2) a single seat's skills or growth are switched off by wrapping the assembler deps adapter (toEngineHeroSkills, or toEngineHeroPassives + toEngineHeroPowerCurve) and deleting that seat from its output (the adapters are keyed by seat and a missing seat is already legal: it is how a hero without a kit is handled); (3) equalization rewrites setup.playerSlots / setup.loadout; (4) a mirror copies one side's roster (with summoner spells), loadout, player stats and tactic to the other side

background.ladder: challenge_ladder_result_3aB.json (e7da437a): the pairing flips are attributed to whole layer steps, not to heroes: drill_rotation > drill_balanced 65.2 -> 95.4 at the skills step (+33.2, 29.4..36.9; includes the assembly order); drill_mirror > drill_topheavy 71.3 -> 48.2 at the growth step (-19.3, -23.9..-14.8); the skills step also shows a lineup-specific side term on mirror>topheavy (S +9.5, z 4.2, descriptive). Per pairing, the frame step is exactly 0 match by match on the two pairings whose tactics are lane-symmetric (m1 vs m6), and non-zero only where m2 or m4 plays
background.drafts: the draft of every pairing is deterministic and identical under v20 and v21 (checked 2026-10-29): rotation>balanced blue chichuan / binghe / bingshuang / leiting / dadi vs red cinderfist / dadi2 / gambler / dawnstrike / fengshen; mirror>topheavy blue ironclad / duskblade / bingshuang / dawnstrike / dadi vs red cinderfist / chichuan / bingshouweis / dadi2 / stoneguard. The flips are therefore not draft changes
background.codeAudit: read-only audit 2026-10-29 (design doc 3a-B_修正規劃_第二輪.md §2.1): no skill, passive or power-curve rule branches on side, seat letter, base position or a fixed forward axis; the asymmetries are evaluation-order effects (players array blue first: same-tick mutual kills resolved blue first so the red killer is already dead and loses the kill XP; the passive step resolves kills one entry at a time in push order; in-loop dashes and pulls move heroes before later (red) casters test geometry) and one A/B confound: heroSkillsOn also switches on about ten non-skill systems. Consequence: a skill context measures kits plus those systems plus their order effects; an engine with heroSkillsOn and no kit cannot be built from the tool

questions.Q1: which heroes' kits carry the rotation>balanced skills-step flip (single-seat skills off in v21, all ten seats)
questions.Q2: which heroes' growth (passive + power curve) carries the mirror>topheavy growth-step flip (single-seat growth off in v21, all ten seats)
questions.Q3: do the flips depend on the player-stat / mastery differences between the fixtures (equalize both teams seat by seat, in L1 and in v21; interaction I = (EQ_v21 - EQ_L1) - (v21 - L1) on the probability and the logit scale)
questions.Q4: skill red/blue symmetry: in a true mirror (both sides the same team, heroes, mastery, stats and tactic; STANDARD layout) does switching the skill layer on move the blue win rate (delta = S(L3a) - S(L1), S = blue win - 0.5), per lineup and pooled; and the growth layer (S(L3) - S(L3a)) for the mirror>topheavy lineups
questions.Q5: TD-3A-23 re-check: in the same mirrors, the frame step S(L1) - S(L0) (v20 legacyMirror -> teamRelative); lineups with a lane-symmetric tactic (m1) must be identical match by match (frame is a no-op for them, as the ladder showed); lineups with m2 / m4 show the legacy lane swap as a side term in L0

contexts.v21: the official challenge.v21 setup (frame, live order, skills, passives, power curve, layout by seed)
contexts.L0: the official challenge.v20 setup (Director static, laneFrame legacyMirror, STANDARD)
contexts.L1: ladder L1_frame: v20 plus the Director / laneFrame group (no skills, no growth, STANDARD)

contexts.L3: ladder L3_growth: L3a plus passives and power curve (STANDARD)

analysis.Q1Q2: per seat: contribution to its own team = (base blue win - KO blue win) for blue seats, (KO blue win - base blue win) for red seats, paired over the seeds; label MATERIAL at |z| >= 2.81 (Bonferroni, 10 seats per pairing), HINT if the unadjusted 95% interval excludes 0, else NONE; every NONE / HINT is printed with its MDE. Review #2: each seat also carries its ceiling on the probability scale (blue seats: base blue win; red seats: 1 - base blue win; RB base is about 96.5% so RB red seats are capped near 3.5 pp and a NONE there is NOT evidence of no effect) and a logit-scale contribution (paired bootstrap); a label that disagrees across scales is SCALE_DEPENDENT. Team sums: paired stats of the per-seed sum of the five seats' signed differences (assumes additivity)
analysis.Q3: interaction I paired per seed on the probability scale, label at |z| >= 2.24 (Bonferroni, 2 pairings); the same contrast on the logit scale by paired bootstrap; disagreement => SCALE_DEPENDENT (review #3: near 96.5% the probability scale compresses, so a probability-scale I can appear with logit additivity); the equalized v21 win rate is reported as the difficulty the pairing would have without stat / mastery differences
analysis.Q4: skill step per lineup and pooled (4 lineups x 300 = 1,200 seed pairs), label at |z| >= 2.58 (Bonferroni, 4 lineups + pooled); verdict SKILL_LAYER_SIDE_EFFECT if the pooled delta is MATERIAL, LINEUP_SPECIFIC if only lineups are, else NOT_DETECTED, always with the MDE. Growth step for the two MT lineups and pooled (600 pairs), label at |z| >= 2.39 (descriptive verdict). S per context pooled over the lineups is reported (S(L1) = the frame context's base side term)
analysis.Q5: frame step per lineup (200 seeds), label at |z| >= 2.50 (Bonferroni, 4); verdict TD3A23_CONSISTENT if both lane-symmetric lineups (mirror, balancedDef) are identical match by match between L0 and L1, else TD3A23_RECHECK; the m2 / m4 lineups' deltas are descriptive (prediction: a non-zero side term in L0 that the teamRelative frame removes)
analysis.power: review #4 (from the committed records: per-seed outcomes across contexts are nearly independent, sd of a paired difference about 0.65-0.70): MDE at 80% power after Bonferroni is about 10 pp for RB blue seats, structurally capped near 3.5 pp for RB red seats, about 15 pp per MT seat (300 seeds), about 7 pp for the pooled mirror skill step, about 14 pp per mirror lineup, about 9 pp for the pooled growth step; the S +9.5 lineup term that motivated Q4 is below the per-lineup MDE, so a per-lineup NOT_DETECTED is weak evidence
interpretation: Q1 / Q2 MATERIAL heroes => candidate hero-content drivers of the flip in this draft and seating; they become candidates for a reverse-orientation or career confirmation (review #3), not a hero-balance verdict by themselves; the fixture calibration must not hide them
Q1 / Q2 no MATERIAL hero but a large team sum => diffuse kit / growth advantage of one lineup: a fixture composition question
Q3 MATERIAL and CONSISTENT across scales => the v21 layers interact with stats / mastery: the calibration must use the fixture stats, not only the draft; SCALE_DEPENDENT => no claim

Q4 SKILL_LAYER_SIDE_EFFECT => skills plus order (L3a includes assemblyOrder live) plus the gated systems move the side term in a perfectly symmetric match: consistent with the audit's order findings; the fix direction is structural (simultaneous resolution or alternating order), not a red/blue number, and needs an Owner decision because it touches the engine
Q4 NOT_DETECTED => no skill side effect above the stated MDE; the challenge side bias is then mainly the pairing / strength design and the layout term
Q5 TD3A23_CONSISTENT => the laneFrame correction acts only where a lane-asymmetric tactic plays, as designed; no further TD-3A-23 change

validation.V0: arm and run-match counts equal the registration
validation.V1a: every analysis seed of a baseline arm has a committed record
validation.V1: the baseline arms reproduce the committed records match by match (winner, duration): RB_v21 / MT_v21 against the side-bias challenge forward records, RB_L1 / MT_L1 against the ladder L1_frame forward records (5 seeds each in --validate, the 20 re-run seeds in --report; any difference => INSTRUMENT)
validation.V2-V4: every record, read from the engine at t=0: Director mode and laneFrame as the context says (L0: static / legacyMirror; others: core.v1 / teamRelative); skills / passives / curve / layout as the context says; the skill-seat list is all ten seats minus exactly the knocked-out seat, the passive and curve seat lists likewise; a mirror has the same hero, power and max HP seat by seat, equal Director identity, and (review #1) under teamRelative equal directive(side, t) without the side field at t = 0 / 600 / 1200 (knobs are world-lane objects, so a lane-asymmetric tactic's red knobs legitimately differ), under legacyMirror equal world knobs
validation.V5: an equalized setup has identical stats, mastery level, powerMult and toughMult seat by seat on both sides

liveCheck: the V2-V4 checks run on every record during --run; any mismatch => HALT
errors: errored matches are never retried; more than 1% errored => STOP(INSTRUMENT)
limitations: the skill context includes the systems that heroSkillsOn also switches on and their order effects (code audit); Q1 attributes kits relative to those systems being on; Q4 cannot separate kits from them or from the live assembly order
the settlement order itself is not varied (Owner 2026-10-29: no order flag, no engine change)

a skills knockout keeps that seat's passive and power curve, but passives triggered by casts go quiet with it; a growth knockout replaces the curve by k = 1 (it removes the curve's level, not only its shape: bingshouweis t=0 power 38.10 -> 40.82)
single-seat knockouts measure a kit's marginal value against having no kit in that seat, not against an average kit; team sums assume additivity
forward orientation only (Q1-Q3); per-hero estimates are for these two drafts and this seating only
the lineup names are the fixture whose snapshot the team comes from; the hero lists are printed in the result (review #5)
logit-scale values clamp probabilities to [0.001, 0.999]; for the RB red seats (base about 96.5%) the logit column is dominated by the clamp and is for reference only (review round 2)
